steps.name: Provision host QEMU and independently installed verification roots
steps.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-system-x86 qemu-utils cloud-image-utils openssh-client
if test -c /dev/kvm; then sudo setfacl -m "u:$(id -un):rw" /dev/kvm; fi
gh --version
gh attestation trusted-root > "$NATIVE_TRUST/trusted_root.jsonl"
if test -n "$PREDECESSOR_RUN"; then
  gh run download "$PREDECESSOR_RUN" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --name "native-runtime-release-$PREDECESSOR_COMMIT" --dir target/native-predecessor
  python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from tools.native_runtime.verify import publisher_policy, RELEASE_WORKFLOW, REPOSITORY
policy = publisher_policy({"schemaVersion": "latent.native-publisher-policy.v1", "repository": REPOSITORY,
                          "workflow": RELEASE_WORKFLOW, "sourceRef": "refs/tags/" + os.environ["PREDECESSOR_VERSION"],
                          "sourceCommit": os.environ["PREDECESSOR_COMMIT"], "version": os.environ["PREDECESSOR_VERSION"],
                          "purpose": "release"}, os.environ["PREDECESSOR_VERSION"])
(Path(os.environ["NATIVE_TRUST"]) / "predecessor-policy.json").write_text(json.dumps(policy))
PY
fi

steps.name: Native packaged execution, real reboot, preservation and selected upgrade
steps.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
arguments=()
if test -n "$PREDECESSOR_RUN"; then
  arguments+=(--predecessor-directory "$PWD/target/native-predecessor" --predecessor-policy "$NATIVE_TRUST/predecessor-policy.json")
fi
if test "$PUBLISH" = true; then arguments+=(--require-upgrade); fi
python3 tools/run_native_vm.py --release-directory "$PWD/target/native-release" \
  --trusted-root "$NATIVE_TRUST/trusted_root.jsonl" --verifier "$(readlink -f "$(command -v gh)")" \
  --version "$NATIVE_VERSION" --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --source-ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
  --purpose release --profile "$NATIVE_PROFILE" --fixture-helper "$PWD/target/native-test-tools/fixture-helper" \
  --output "$PWD/target/native-vm/$NATIVE_PROFILE.json" "${arguments[@]}"
